decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enter-the-battlefield abilities to tutor for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, creating a "toolbox" of options to deal with various threats. The deck also aims to generate value through sacrificing creatures with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Blood Artist, while providing consistent mana fixing and ramp with lands like Golgari Rot Farm and Arboreal Grazer. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile creature-based combo strategy that can adapt to different situations.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity as a combo piece to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also leverages the planeswalkers Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and generate value. The inclusion of cards like Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding adds additional utility and disruption to enhance the overall strategy. With a mix of spells and lands that support the combo-centric gameplay, this deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents through unique and creative interactions.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy involves playing efficient creatures such as Wild Nacatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also using spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to clear the way and finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra mana flexibility. Additionally, the deck includes Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's game plan and Stubborn Denial for added protection. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful assault.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect your threats and control the game. Thought Scour and Mishra's Bauble are used for card selection and graveyard manipulation, while Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal options. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and maintaining tempo throughout the match.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays combined with the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck can put intense pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower provide additional threats and disruption, while cards like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation offer versatility and protection. Overall, the deck aims to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Underworld Breach along with efficient card selection and disruption spells to create a powerful win condition. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Expressive Iteration, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces while utilizing Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat for removal and disruption. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo from opposing disruption, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and consistency. The goal is to efficiently execute the combo to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently control the game using the UrzaTron lands to generate abundant mana. By assembling Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower, the deck can ramp up quickly to cast powerful spells and creatures like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional flexibility and ramp potential. With access to colorless mana and a variety of threats and answers, this control deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents in a long game.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana. It utilizes a variety of colorless spells and powerful threats like Sundering Titan, Karn Liberated, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the game. The inclusion of cards like Expedition Map, Ancient Stirrings, and Sylvan Scrying helps find the necessary pieces quickly. Additionally, the deck can use Karn, the Great Creator to access a sideboard full of artifacts to further disrupt opponents and gain advantage.

This deck relies on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells and threats ahead of schedule. The deck also includes a variety of color-fixing artifacts and utility lands to support the Tron lands. With access to versatile options such as Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Engineered Explosives, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategies, and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats like Ulamog or Karn, the Great Creator.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources and gradually overwhelming them with big threats. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal, card advantage engines, and versatile threats to adapt to different matchups. By managing the board and applying pressure with its threats, the deck seeks to outvalue and outpace the opponent to secure victory. It is a versatile and adaptive control deck designed to handle a variety of situations.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays using powerful creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Grief. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to protect its creatures and ensure they stick around to deal damage. The key strategy of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to quickly defeat the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, creating a powerful combo engine. The goal is to use cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder to fill the graveyard with spells, while also generating value with Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also utilizing cantrips like Consider and Expressive Iteration to dig for combo pieces.

This deck focuses on utilizing Hardened Scales to maximize the value of +1/+1 counters on creatures like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista. It also includes artifact synergies with Arcbound Ravager and The Ozolith to create a fast and aggressive board presence. With cards like Urza's Saga and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, the deck aims to quickly build up a threatening board state and overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful interactions. By combining aggro strategies with counters and artifacts, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main idea of this deck is to play aggressively with cheap and efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to filter through your deck and find the cards you need. Unholy Heat serves as removal for problematic creatures, and card draw is provided by Consider and Thought Scour. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the game through tempo plays and card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and applying pressure to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate card advantage and deal damage efficiently. Mayhem Devil and Goblin Bombardment are included to maximize damage output and punish the opponent for blocking or removing creatures. With a mix of removal spells like Terminate and disruptive cards like Grief, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast clock to close out games.

The archetype of this deck focuses on using the UrzaTron lands to ramp up quickly and generate a large amount of mana in order to control the game. The deck includes a variety of powerful artifact cards, such as Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone, to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control. By efficiently using mana fixing and card draw spells, the deck aims to establish a dominant position on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disruptive spells.
